unresolved.description: The filled twin does not preserve the reference shield's expanded outer contour: the final enlarged filled proof and resolved SVG show a sharp lower tip and tighter shoulders, whereas the filled references have a rounded tip and broader shoulder transitions. The only admitted shield is a closed centerline part. The DSL lacks closed-part stroke expansion with interior union, or an outward offset operation, and no admitted filled boundary is available; fitting the source interior cannot reproduce that required contour.

Exact family centering remains uncertain: the fitted filled body occupies x=3..20.792, centered at 11.896 against the check and outlined body at x=12. The final native matrix has rows[7][3]=0 versus rows[7][20]=53, and retina rows[14][6]=0 versus rows[14][41]=106. This small asymmetric placement is visible in edge coverage and does not fully preserve the reference's symmetric body alignment.

meaning.evidence: Both paints show a shield (flat top, curved shoulders, rounded bottom point) containing a single V-stroke: in native.png the outlined check spans x8-x15, rows 8-14, elbow at x9-x11/rows 12-13, long arm rising right to x14-x15/row 9. No cross, keyhole/shackle or exclamation stroke is present, and the filled knockout sits in the identical local cells.

style.evidence: At the native1x/2x columns the candidate's shield corner radii, shoulder curve and bottom taper match reference-0 and reference-2 outlined, and the filled silhouette matches reference-1/reference-3; the outlined modifier's declared width 2 with round caps equals reference-2's declared facts and reads at the same apparent weight as that reference's X on both surfaces. The filled check is knockout geometry with no measurable stroke, judged perceptually as level with reference-3's knockout X.

optics.evidence: In native.png the outlined check clears the shield wall by three white pixels each side (row 11 x5-x7 = 255; row 9 x16-x18 = 255) and the shield counter stays open to row 18 (x10-x12 = 255). The filled knockout stays continuous white along its length (row 12 x33-x36 = 254) with only a partial 106 dip at the inner elbow (row 11 x34-x35), a softened corner rather than a break.

family.evidence: Outlined and filled share concept, bounds and modifier placement: the shield's left wall begins at the same column in both (row 5 local x3/x27 = 157/158) and the check occupies local x8-x15, rows 8-14 in each paint. Differences are limited to paint inversion and the filled elbow's softened inner corner.

meaning.evidence: Inside the folder body (native.png rows 9-16, x9-14) an arched shackle with an open counter (row 11 x11-12 = 197/196, row 12 = 255) sits on a solid rectangular block at rows 13-16 - a padlock, not an arrow, check or briefcase handle. The container has the top-left tab and rounded outline of the folder silhouette shared with references 2/3.
meaning.treatment: None; the modifier is unambiguous at native size.

style.evidence: At the labelled native1x/2x columns the candidate's folder tab, corner radii and outline weight read at the same optical weight as reference-2's, and its mixed paint (2-unit stroked shackle plus solid lock body inside a stroked folder) matches reference-2's solid arrowhead on a 2-unit stem. Host facts confirm the outlined candidate declares 2-unit strokes with round caps like references 0/2, and the filled candidate declares none like references 1/3.
style.treatment: None required for an observed defect.

optics.evidence: Outlined 1x: the shackle counter is open (row 12 x11-12 = 255) and the lock clears the folder walls with 4 white px each side (row 14 x4-7 and x16-19 = 255), with a full white pixel of clearance below the top edge at row 8. The only difference is a sub-pixel edge softness on the filled bottom row (row 19 = 85 gray vs the outlined's solid 0), which is rasterization, not a layout change.

unresolved.description: The requirement to preserve meaningful frame geometry at native size remains uncertain: the narrow rear frame opening above the rear wheel is clear in enlarged contours but resolves mainly as a faint diagonal at 24px/1x in both paints, and is weaker than the main frame triangle in the matching 2x columns. The wheel counters and connected frame survive, but the rear triangle is not equally legible.

meaning.evidence: Two equal-diameter spoked-looking wheels sit at the same baseline (native.png rows 12-19, x=2-9 and x=14-21) joined by a diamond frame with an open triangular counter, plus raised handlebars at upper left (rows 4-7, x=4-8) and a saddle at upper right (rows 4-7, x=13-16). No engine mass, no seat-back or push-ring, no footboard, so motorcycle, wheelchair and scooter are excluded.
meaning.treatment: None needed; the subject reads unambiguously.

style.evidence: At the same 24px surface the outlined candidate is far denser than references 0 and 2, whose 2px strokes keep 3px+ open interiors (car body, wheelchair wheel C-opening), whereas the candidate's hubs close to a single light column (native.png row 15, x=4 = 226 between ring at x=2-3 and solid black x=5-12). The filled candidate also fails to become a solid mass with cut slots the way references 1 and 3 do; it is a stroke expansion that renders identically to the outlined paint at both 1x and 2x.
style.treatment: Raise the wheel diameter and move the fork/down-tube junction outside the hub so each interior holds a 2-3px open counter matching references 0 and 2 at 24px; redraw the filled paint as a solid silhouette with cut slots in the manner of references 1 and 3 rather than expanding the outlined strokes.

optics.evidence: At 1x the left wheel hub retains only a 1px light crescent (native.png rows 15-16, x=4 = 226/227; row 17, x=5-6 = 226) with the rest of the interior at 0, and the right hub is cut into two 1px slivers by a dark bar at x=17-18 in rows 14-15, so both wheels read as blobs rather than wheels; the same collapse appears in both halves of the strip and inverts to hairline dark notches on the dark surface. The counters only recover at 2x.
optics.treatment: Enlarge the wheels and shift the fork and seat-tube crossings off the hub centres, snapping each ring's inner edge to whole pixels so a >=2px counter survives at 24px on both surfaces.

family.evidence: Both paints place the same bicycle at the same scale and layout: wheel rings, frame triangle, handlebar and saddle land on identical rows and columns, with only antialias-level differences (native.png row 12, x=3-20 vs x=27-44). Within each paint the two repeated wheels share diameter, ring weight and baseline.
family.treatment: None needed for concept, scale or layout; the lack of any visible difference between the outlined and filled paints is reported under style.
